title: Compulsive behaviour
learning_outcomes: Explain compulsion and impairment in the context of compulsive behaviour.
Compare and distinguish contextual triggers in the context of compulsive behaviour.
Apply support pathways in the context of compulsive behaviour.
Evaluate and justify decisions about withdrawal and referral boundaries in the context of compulsive behaviour.

lessons.title: Compulsion and impairment
lessons.outcome: Explain compulsion and impairment in the context of compulsive behaviour.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving compulsion and impairment; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional support map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain compulsion and impairment from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of compulsion and impairment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Contextual triggers
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish contextual triggers in the context of compulsive behaviour.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving contextual triggers; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional support map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain contextual triggers from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of contextual triggers; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Support pathways
lessons.outcome: Apply support pathways in the context of compulsive behaviour.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving support pathways; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional support map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain support pathways from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of support pathways; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Withdrawal and referral boundaries
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about withdrawal and referral boundaries in the context of compulsive behaviour.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving withdrawal and referral boundaries; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional support map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain withdrawal and referral boundaries from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of withdrawal and referral boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of compulsion and impairment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of contextual triggers; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of support pathways; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of withdrawal and referral boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
